name: metaspacer
description: Model and explore metagenomic spaces with explicit uncertainty and extrapolation tiers.

scripts.lint: eslint . && Rscript -e "lints <- unlist(lapply(c('scripts', 'rpkg/R', 'rpkg/tests'), lintr::lint_dir)); print(lints); quit(status = length(lints))"
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
